content.title: Tesla Stock Drops as U.S. Auto Regulator Probes Alleged Model 3 Door Defects
content.summary: The U.S. auto safety regulator has opened an investigation into the mechanical door release on the 2022  Tesla  Model 3. Tesla didn’t immediately respond to Barron’s request for comment.
